displayAddress: Central Exchange, Grey Street, Newcastle Upon Tyne
description:
The superb three-bedroom duplex flat is in the heart of Newcastle upon Tyne, overlooking Grey’s Monument. This well-located apartment offers flexible accommodation suited to first-time buyers, families, investors or those seeking university accommodation.  Situated within a prime position of this Grade II listed converted building.

Arranged over two levels, the flat features an open-plan kitchen with dining space and good natural light, creating a practical area for cooking and entertaining. The adjoining reception space includes a spiral staircase linking the two floors, adding character and a clear division between living and sleeping areas. The main bedroom is a double with en-suite facilities, while two further bedrooms provides additional accommodation. There is a family bathroom/w.c and a separate w.c. offering convenience for multiple occupants.

The property benefits from parking in Pudding Chare, a valuable asset in this central location. An EPC rating of D is recorded.

Situated on Grey Street, the flat is moments from the Newcastle Theatre Royal and the many shops, cafés, bars and restaurants of the city centre and nearby Grey Street and Grainger Town. Monument Metro station is close by, providing direct links across Tyneside, including Newcastle Central Station, the coast and Newcastle International Airport. Central Station also offers mainline rail services to Edinburgh, London and other major UK cities, with journey times to London in around three hours.

The central position also places Newcastle and Northumbria Universities within easy reach, as well as the Quayside and its riverside walks, making this flat a practical base for city living.
